name: Liferun

Meta remains the sole lead-generating channel, delivering all 145 leads at a $17.69 CPL, but the reduced budget pressure has nudged CPL up 7.92%, signaling a need to either reinstate Google spend or investigate its conversion tracking.

performance.verdict: Google's $1,074 is confirmed dead weight; Meta efficiency now the only lever.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $1,074.05 over 28 days and returned 0 conversions — confirmed pixel/tracking failure, not audience failure; 171 clicks did land.
Meta CPL rose 7.92% (7d delta) and 3-day signal confirms it: leads Aug 17-19 averaged 7/day vs 12.7/day Aug 14-16, while spend held ~$100/day.
SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA marked Done 2026-07-20, but GHL shows 0 won opportunities and $0 won value across 130 created opps — completion unverified in live data.
GHL pipeline has 160 contacts vs 145 Meta leads — 15-contact gap with 0 appointments and 0 won opps suggests intake leak: leads arriving but not being worked.
GBP actions fell 63.64% (7d) and hit 0 for the last 4 consecutive days (Aug 16-19), coinciding with reduced paid spend — organic floor is thin.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads spend entirely until conversion tracking is confirmed firing — $1,074.05 spent with 0 conversions over 28 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause all Google Ads campaigns immediately; $1,074.05 was spent over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions and 0 pipeline opps attributable to Google. Before reinstating, confirm the conversion pixel fires on a test lead submission and logs inside Google Ads. Redirect the freed daily Google budget (~$14–$43/day based on recent spend) to Meta once tracking is verified. Success check: first conversion recorded in Google Ads dashboard by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 160 contacts vs 0 appointments and 0 won opps — identify where the 130 created opportunities are stalling in the pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: Pull the 130 created opportunities in GHL and identify which stage they are stalling at — specifically check whether Becklar deactivation and BWS duplicate flows (per SOW Aug–Sep tasks) are creating phantom opps or blocking progression. The 0 appointments and $0 won value against 145 leads points to a CRM workflow break, not an ads problem. Success check: stage-by-stage opp breakdown documented and at least one end-to-end test order confirmed clean by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL: 3-day lead average dropped to 7/day from 12.7/day — re-check in 3 days before any creative refresh decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL has risen 7.92% week-over-week and the 3-day lead average (Aug 17–19) is 7/day versus 12.7/day the prior 3 days, with spend stable near $100/day. Do not act on creative refresh until the 3-day window (Aug 23) confirms the dip is sustained rather than a weekend pattern. If leads remain below 8/day on Aug 23 with spend holding, escalate to a creative_refresh suggestion. Re-check date: 2026-08-23.
